articles.제목: France launches roadmap for fusion energy development
articles.원문 요약: Philippe Baptiste, France's Minister for Higher Education, Research and Space, has announced the country’s new ten-year strategy for fusion energy development.

articles.제목: New York names contenders for next step of nuclear programme
articles.원문 요약: The New York Power Authority announced the names of the ten nuclear energy developers it has qualified to go forward in its process to select potential partners for its effort to develop at least 1 GWe of advanced nuclear power capacity in Upstate New York.

articles.제목: Chernobyl and Fukushima sharing decommissioning experience
articles.원문 요약: Experts from the Chernobyl and Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plants are sharing experience on how to safely decommission the units destroyed in their respective accidents.

ENTRA1 teams up with Sargent & Lundy for SMR deployment
articles.원문 요약: Sargent & Lundy is partnering with ENTRA1 Energy to provide engineering and design support for the development and execution of ENTRA1 Energy Plants based on NuScale Power's small modular reactor technology.

articles.제목: Prototype aseismic bearing completed for Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.원문 요약: Construction company Skanska has completed an aseismic bearing pedestal demonstrator for Rolls-Royce SMR. These structural isolation devices are a key part of the factory-built nuclear power plant's design.

articles.제목: Maritime nuclear project awarded Norwegian public funds
articles.원문 요약: The Research Council of Norway has awarded NOK20 million (USD2 million) in initial funding to the Marine Nuclear Propulsion System project as it prepares to move maritime nuclear propulsion from system development towards physical integration and testing.

articles.제목: IAEA mission sees commitment to safety at Shin Kori 2
articles.원문 요약: There is a clear commitment to operational safety and continuous improvement at unit 2 of Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power's Shin Kori nuclear power plant, an International Atomic Energy Agency mission has found.

articles.제목: Nuclear M&A deals total USD10.3 billion in first nine months of 2026
articles.원문 요약: Deals totalling USD10.3 billion were completed in the first nine months of 2026, with global nuclear mergers and acquisitions well placed to beat 2025's full year USD11.2 billion, research by law firm White & Case LLP suggests.
